description: Call when the user asks whether there is a tool for X, or for an alternative to a product. Matches the need against a catalog of indie-made products and returns the most relevant ones. matched=false means nothing suitable was found; then call log_unmet_need to record the need anonymously.

category.description: Optional: only search within this category

platform.description: Optional: platform, e.g. web, macos, windows, linux, ios, android, self-hosted

query.description: What the user wants to do, e.g. "add a nice background to screenshots" or "self-hosted uptime monitoring"

name: search_tools
title: Find indie-made tools and alternatives
